hero.headline: How We Create Together
hero.intro: Our governance, economic, and organizational systems are designed to ensure all beings belong and thrive.

items.title: Sociocracy & Teal
items.description: We blend sociocratic governance with Teal organization principles. Self-management, wholeness, and evolutionary purpose guide our structure.

items.title: Adaptive Governance
items.description: Using Hypha tools, each circle designs its own governance strategy, from consent to consensus, tailored to its unique culture, values, and mission.

items.title: {token}
items.description: Recognition from the community. {village} sets its own rules for it and for its other tokens, and changes them by agreement.

items.title: Seasonal Rhythm
items.description: Every 3 months, the community decides together what kind of season comes next, a living response to what {village} needs most right now.

tokens.heading: Our Tokens
tokens.intro: {village} keeps its own tokens, {token} among them. Their rules are the community's to design.

governance.heading: Our Governance Structure
governance.intro: Multi-tiered governance balancing development expertise with community wisdom.

hypha.heading: Flexible Governance with Hypha
hypha.intro: Inspired by Teal and sociocracy, we use **Hypha.earth** tools to let each circle design its own governance strategy. No one-size-fits-all-each space can tailor decision-making to its unique culture, values, and mission.
hypha.boxBody: Hypha provides tools to formalize agreements, track roles, and manage proposals. Each circle can configure voting thresholds, quorum requirements, and decision timeframes. This creates transparency while honoring each group's autonomy. All agreements and role assignments are recorded on-chain for accountability.

methods.name: Consent
methods.description: No objections means the proposal passes. Fast and efficient for most decisions.

methods.name: Consensus
methods.description: Everyone actively agrees. Builds deep alignment but takes more time.

methods.name: Advice Process
methods.description: Anyone can make a decision after seeking advice from affected parties.

methods.name: Custom Blend
methods.description: Mix and match methods based on decision type and urgency.

seasons.heading: Seasonal Rhythm
seasons.intro: Every 3 months, the community votes on what kind of season comes next, a collective response to what {village} needs most. Each season is its own chapter.
seasons.note: **No fixed cycle.** At the end of each season, the community comes together to vote on what's needed next. A village that just built all summer might choose Winter to design what comes next. A village deep in planning might choose Spring to break ground. The seasons follow {village}'s needs, not a calendar.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.title: Spring Season
seasons.description: Breaking ground. Starting new buildings, projects, and initiatives. The season for bold beginnings and planting what we want to grow.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.title: Summer Season
seasons.description: Full momentum. Festivals, events, gatherings, and high community activity. The season to show up, celebrate, and build together at full energy.

seasons.name: Fall
seasons.title: Fall Season
seasons.description: Harvest time. Reflection, lessons learned, and appreciating the abundance we've created. The season to gather what we've grown and give thanks.

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.title: Winter Season
seasons.description: Deep design. Systems redesign, governance evolution, economic modelling, financial preparation, and investor relations. The season to think long.

cta.heading: Learn More
cta.body: Dive deeper into our governance and economic systems in the Co-Creators Guide, or join a community call to ask questions.
